title: Expose Tide (Screen 1) trend per historical bar in GET /api/stocks/{ticker}/indicators
description: docs/ideas.md's first entry (chart shading of Screen 1 bull/bear/neutral regions) needs `tide.trend` per historical bar, but `IndicatorHistoryPoint` (backend/app/api/schemas.py) only ever projects out signal/confidence/indicators/wave fields today, even though `analyse_history()` (backend/app/signals/engine.py) already recomputes Screen 1 fresh for every bar (via `_weekly_through_bar_date`) as part of its own per-bar `SignalResult`. This is pure plumbing -- no new computation -- add a `tide_trend` (or nested `tide`) field to `IndicatorHistoryPoint`, sourced from each bar's already-computed `screens['tide']['trend']`. This is the backend prerequisite for the tide-region chart-shading frontend task; nothing else currently blocks it.

checklist.step: Decide the exact field shape (flat `tide_trend: 'BULLISH'|'BEARISH'|'NEUTRAL'` vs a nested `tide` object matching the /analysis response's own screens.tide shape) and record as a decisions entry -- prefer consistency with the existing /analysis schema unless there's a good reason not to.
Add the field to IndicatorHistoryPoint in backend/app/api/schemas.py, sourced from analyse_history()'s existing per-bar result.
Unit test covering a ticker whose historical Tide trend actually changes across the returned range (not a fixture that's constant BULLISH throughout, which wouldn't catch a wiring bug).
Confirm the last point in the response still matches GET /api/stocks/{ticker}/analysis's own screens.tide.trend for the same ticker/date, per this endpoint's existing documented invariant.
